tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

A Consortium consists of a Lead Bidder and one Consortium Member, with a maximum of 2 partners including the Lead Bidder, entering into a Consortium Agreement for the common objective of satisfying the requirements of Mangaluru City Corporation, and represented by the Lead Bidder
The responsibility for successful execution of the entire project would rest with the Sole Bidder or Lead Bidder in case of a Consortium Bid.

The Consortium Members should have relevant experience of executing similar roles and responsibilities. For the purpose of technical evaluation, net worth and turnover of only the bidding entity shall be considered. Net worth and turnover of any parent, subsidiary, associate or other related entity shall not be considered

The list of Consortium Members needs to be declared in the bid and cannot be changed by the bidder later on. Any change in the Consortium Partner will require approval of the Commissioner, Mangaluru City Corporation.

Bids submitted by a Consortium should comply with the following requirements: i)The Lead Bidder shall be authorized to incur liabilities and receive instructions for and on behalf of all Consortium Members. Entire execution of the Contract, including payment, shall be done exclusively by/with the Lead Bidder. ii)Internal arrangement between the Consortium Members is left to the bidders. It is the responsibility of the Lead Bidder to ensure that the Consortium Members in the bid are compliant with all the clauses mentioned in the bid, failing which may lead to disqualification.
An agency cannot be a member of more than one Consortium, either as a Lead Bidder or as a Consortium Partner, for the same tender
An agency participating as a Sole Bidder cannot be a Lead Bidder or a member of any other Consortium for the same work floated by Mangaluru City Corporation.

The Commissioner, Mangaluru City Corporation, reserves the right to reject any or all of the Proposals without thereby incurring any liability or obligation to inform the Bidder of the reasons for such action.
Interested eligible Bidder may obtain further information from the Office of the Commissioner, Mangaluru City Corporation, on all working days during working hours.
Bidders have to clearly indicate whether the proposal is submitted individually or as a Consortium.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Key Personnel (Team Composition):1)Team Leader/PM (Greater than or equal to 15 yrs, GIS/Aerial Survey relevant): 5 marks, 2)UAV/Drone Expert with RPL (Greater than or equal to 5 yrs):5 marks 3)LiDAR/Photogrammetry Specialist (Greater than or equal to 8 yrs): 5 marks 4)Drone Data Processing Expert (Greater than or equal to 15 yrs, GIS/Aerial Survey relevant): 3 marks 5)Senior GIS Analyst (Greater than or equal to 8 yrs): 4 marks 6)GNSS/Ground Survey Expert (Greater than or equal to 8 yrs, Licensed 4 marks 6)GNSS/Ground Survey Expert (Greater than or equal to 8 yrs, Licensed Surveyor): 4 marks 7)GIS Application Developer (Greater than or equal to 5 yrs): 2 marks 8)Quality Control Officer (Greater than or equal to 5 yrs)): 2 marks (Marks split:30% qualification+70% relevant experience)

Past Project Experience: 1)UAV/Drone survey of urban area Greater than or equal to 25 sqkm (10 marks, max 1 project), 2)LiDAR airborne acquisition and processing (5 marks, max 1), 3)GIS database for ULB/government (5 marks, max 1), 4)Geospatial project value Greater than Rs.30 Lakh (3 marks, max 1), Projects completed on time per completion certificate (2 marks, max 1)

Technical Approach and Methodology: 1) Understanding of scope and project area (5 marks),2) UAV acquisition plan-equipment, GSD, overlap, weather, DGCA (5 marks), 3)LiDAR acquisition plan-sensor, density, strip plan (5 marks), 4)GCP strategy and accuracy plan (3 marks), 5)Processing methodology-AT, LiDAR, 3D Mesh, GIS (7 marks), 6)QA/QC Plan-internal QC, checkpoints, accuracy assessment (5 marks), 7)Data delivery and training plan (5 marks)

Evaluation of Sample data for not less than 5 sqkm: 1)The bidder shall do a demonstration using sample local data covering an area of not less than 5 square kilometres. 2)The data capturing activity may be undertaken by the bidders during the entire bidding process at their own cost, expense. The sample data and outputs submitted by the bidders shall be evaluated by the Technical Evaluation Committee as part of the Technical Evaluation.3)The dataset prepared for areas under Mangaluru City Corporation (MCC) limits shall carry 50% weightage under the relevant Technical Evaluation criterion.

Work Programme and Resource Plan: 1) Feasibility and detail of project schedule (5 marks), 2) Resource deployment plan-personnel and equipment mobilisation (5 marks), 3) Risk identification and mitigation strategy (3marks), 4) Contingency for weather, DGCA delays, data failures (2 marks)
Technical Presentation: 1)Clarity, depth, and confidence in presenting proposal to BEC, 2)Ability to address BEC queries Demonstration of local knowledge of Mangaluru/MCC context
